title: Pixel-precise continuous viewport pan with stable log-price scale and live SVG layer transforms
changes: Replace integer-bar snapping with floating logical time offsets; wheel zoom preserves cursor time.
Pan existing cached SVG OHLC, 1D HA, Bollinger and drawings using requestAnimationFrame without replacing the SVG during pointermove.
Freeze inspected crosshair price/time during drag; commit precise log-price viewport after release and restore cursor inspection.
Retain already-loaded history outside the clipped viewport and remove the legacy fewer-than-21-visible-candles blank state.
Add independently persisted manual log-price viewport per chart; price-axis double-click restores auto scale.
Preserve existing Pionex WebSocket, CoinGlass 7D six-version decoding, RR, S-state, 4-window drawing/notifications and Worker/R2.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite seven files in MultiAssetLiquidityRadar; no Cloudflare Worker/R2/API changes.
validationNote: Chromium tests with synthetic K-lines and local script injection passed. No assertion of identical TradingView Advanced Charts internals or real-market long-duration framerate.
